title: close, archive and demote relocate records too, but the completion staging hint is complete-only
description:
Found while implementing QCLI-311 (opum-ai/quest-cli#419) and filed rather than absorbed into that task. QCLI-221 makes status and on-disk location independent, and exactly four commands relocate a record: task complete, task close, task archive and task demote. The QCLI-311 slice added the human-surface staging hint to task complete only (completionStagingHint in src/cli/main.ts, gated on command === complete), while the task-finalization guide names the other three in a single sentence. So close, archive and demote still carry the commit-staging hazard QCLI-311 closed for complete, through the same composition: the move is left unstaged, and a repo-wide git add -A used to stage it also stages any unrelated tracked file merely missing from the working tree.

Ruled by opum-agent 2026-09-29 as EXECUTION, the same shape as QCLI-311 option 2: extend the human-surface hint to the other three relocating commands. Human text output only (plain and pretty); the JSON envelope stays unchanged.

Notes for whoever takes it:
1. Each command needs its OWN destination named, not a hardcoded one: complete and close move a record into .quest/completed/, archive moves it to the archive location, and demote moves it back toward tasks/. Derive the destination from the operation, and verify each by running the real commands in a disposable workspace the way QCLI-311 did, rather than asserting the behaviour from reading the code.
2. The forms to name are the scoped git add -A .quest/, or the record two paths; both were measured to stage a rename (git 2.55.0; see QCLI-311 implementation notes for the measurements).
3. Tests: extend test/qcli311-completion-staging-hint.test.ts or add a sibling; keep asserting the JSON envelope key order for every command touched.

Evidence: PR opum-ai/quest-cli#419; the guide section The commit that carries a completion in src/application/agents/guides.ts.
